description: The cancel route restricts to run owner OR org admin (lines 185-191), but the restart route only calls checkOrgMember, so any non-owner org member can restart (and thereby re-attribute) a run they do not own.
reason: Restart route (lines 229-236) gates only on checkOrgMember, while cancel (lines 185-188) requires owner-or-checkOrgAdmin; restartWorkflowRun calls wfManager.createWorkflowRun(originalRun.orgId, userId, ...) at orchestrator line 1524, attributing the fresh run to the caller, so any org member can restart and re-own another user's run.

description: req.query.status is cast directly to WorkflowRunStatus[] (options.statuses = [status as WorkflowRunStatus]) with no check against the allowed enum ('queued'|'running'|'cancelling'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled'|'paused'), so an invalid status string is passed unchecked into listWorkflowRuns.
reason: Line 123 casts the raw query string to WorkflowRunStatus with no enum check (enum defined types.ts:4683-4690), and listWorkflowRuns forwards it into a Firestore '.where(status, in, [...])' (workflow-manager.ts:691-692); impact is benign (empty result set, not an error/injection) so MEDIUM is generous but the unvalidated-cast claim is accurate.

description: limit is only guarded by !isNaN(limit); a negative or zero limit (e.g. ?limit=-5) passes the check and is forwarded to listWorkflowRuns without bounds validation.
reason: For ?limit=-5, line 124 'if (limit && !isNaN(limit))' is true so options.limit=-5 reaches listWorkflowRuns and query.limit(-5) (workflow-manager.ts:695-696), which Firestore rejects; note zero is actually filtered out (0 is falsy), so the 'zero' part of the description is wrong but the negative-limit bounds gap is real.

description: inputs is read from req.body and forwarded as inputs ?? {} (line 61) without verifying it is a plain object, so a client sending inputs as an array, string, or number passes it unchecked into orchestrator.startRun.
reason: Line 61 forwards 'inputs ?? {}' into startRun(...) (orchestrator.ts:641) which stores it via createWorkflowRun (orchestrator.ts:696) with no plain-object check, so a non-object body value passes unchecked; real but low-impact input-hardening gap.
